name: Lotte New York Palace
insider_take: This iconic Midtown Manhattan palace seamlessly blends Gilded Age grandeur with modern luxury, occupying a full city block in the heart of everything that matters.
whats_special: The hotel incorporates the historic Villard Houses, built in 1882 by railroad magnate Henry Villard and designed by McKim, Mead & White. The stunning Gold Room features 24-karat gold leaf ceilings and served as the inspiration for the ballroom scenes in "Gossip Girl." St. Patrick's Cathedral sits directly across the street, while Rockefeller Center and Fifth Avenue shopping are just steps away.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 45-55 for breathtaking views of Central Park and the city skyline. The hotel's courtyard entrance on Madison Avenue offers a more discrete arrival away from the bustling street scene.
dont_miss: Afternoon tea in the opulent Villard Bar & Lounge, housed in the original 1882 mansion with its soaring coffered ceilings and Renaissance Revival details. The rooftop terrace on the 50th floor provides stunning 360-degree views of Manhattan's skyline.
pros: Prime Midtown Manhattan location near St. Patrick's Cathedral
Historic palace architecture with modern luxury amenities
World-class dining options and rooftop experiences
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury Manhattan location
Busy tourist area with heavy foot traffic
